title: SWE-rebench V2 confirmatory case acceptance record
description: Structural record contract. Passing it does not independently verify referenced artifacts, licenses, reviewer identity, or semantic judgments.

source.description: Exact upstream provenance, immutable revisions and source snapshot digests; see validator for required fields.

independence.description: Independent project and defect-cluster review with a hashed review record.

exposure.description: Exposure and blinding audit; confirmatory analyst must not have seen gold cause/fix.

license_review.description: Exact base and changed-file/source license review, including third-party content.

technical_reproduction.description: Recorded buggy-baseline failure and fixed-revision pass under a locked environment.

gold_standard.description: Two independent Panel A ratings plus documented consensus/adjudication and alternatives.

evidence_tiers.description: Two disjoint, blinded Panel B ratings and locked E1/E2/E3 survivor sets with nestedness.
